title: adapt-global.com
description: The company sells to federal customers under a GSA MAS contract and calls its products "U.S.-made / Made in the USA," yet its own documents reveal Taiwanese and Chinese suppliers, Hong Kong-based developer and manufacturer TMG, budgets in Shanghai and Zhongshan, molds worth $1,698,109.75, and "tariff surcharges" of 3% to 20% in commercial quotes — in the $4,573.20 Mazda order, exactly ×1.20, with a footer reading "TARIFF SURCHARGE." For FDA-RFQ-21-1243788 for the Comfort Zone software, the archive contains proposals dated June 7 and 9, 2021 — two months before the request was published on Augu
